import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static int n, T;
    static char[][] board1 = new char[15][15];
    static char[][] board2 = new char[15][15];
    static int[][] node_id = new int[15][15];
    static int node_cnt;
    static int zero_r, zero_c;
    static final int[] dr = {0, 0, 1, -1};
    static final int[] dc = {1, -1, 0, 0};

    static class Edge {
        int to, cap, rev;
        Edge(int t, int c, int r) {
            to = t;
            cap = c;
            rev = r;
        }
    }

    static List<Edge>[] adj;
    static int[] lvl;
    static int[] ptr;

    static boolean valid(int r, int c) {
        return r >= 0 && c >= 0 && r < n && c < n && board1[r][c] >= '0' && board1[r][c] <= '9';
    }

    static void connect(int u, int v, int c) {
        adj[u].add(new Edge(v, c, adj[v].size()));
        adj[v].add(new Edge(u, 0, adj[u].size() - 1));
    }

    static void expand(int r, int c) {
        if (board2[r][c] != 0) {
            connect(node_id[r][c] + node_cnt, 2 * node_cnt + 1, board2[r][c] - '0');
        }
        if (board1[r][c] == '0') return;
        
        connect(0, node_id[r][c], board1[r][c] - '0');
        if (board2[r][c] != 0) {
            connect(node_id[r][c], node_id[r][c] + node_cnt, 10);
        }

        int sr = r, sc = c;
        Queue<Integer> q1r = new LinkedList<>();
        Queue<Integer> q1c = new LinkedList<>();
        Queue<Integer> q2r = new LinkedList<>();
        Queue<Integer> q2c = new LinkedList<>();
        q1r.add(r); q1c.add(c);
        q2r.add(zero_r); q2c.add(zero_c);

        int[][] d1 = new int[n][n];
        int[][] d2 = new int[n][n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            Arrays.fill(d1[i], -1);
            Arrays.fill(d2[i], -1);
        }
        d1[r][c] = 0;
        d2[zero_r][zero_c] = 0;

        while (!q1r.isEmpty()) {
            int sz = q1r.size();
            for (int i = 0; i < sz; ++i) {
                int ur = q1r.poll();
                int uc = q1c.poll();
                if (d2[ur][uc] >= 0) continue;
                for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                    int nr = ur + dr[k], nc = uc + dc[k];
                    if (valid(nr, nc) && d1[nr][nc] == -1) {
                        d1[nr][nc] = d1[ur][uc] + 1;
                        if (d1[nr][nc] > T) break;
                        if (d2[nr][nc] >= 0) continue;
                        q1r.add(nr); q1c.add(nc);
                        if (board2[nr][nc] != '0') {
                            connect(node_id[sr][sc], node_id[nr][nc] + node_cnt, 10);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            sz = q2r.size();
            for (int i = 0; i < sz; ++i) {
                int ur = q2r.poll();
                int uc = q2c.poll();
                for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                    int nr = ur + dr[k], nc = uc + dc[k];
                    if (valid(nr, nc) && d2[nr][nc] == -1) {
                        d2[nr][nc] = d2[ur][uc] + 1;
                        q2r.add(nr); q2c.add(nc);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static boolean bfs_level() {
        Arrays.fill(lvl, -1);
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(0);
        lvl[0] = 0;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            for (Edge e : adj[u]) {
                if (e.cap > 0 && lvl[e.to] == -1) {
                    lvl[e.to] = lvl[u] + 1;
                    q.add(e.to);
                }
            }
        }
        return lvl[2 * node_cnt + 1] != -1;
    }

    static int dfs_flow(int u, int flow) {
        if (u == 2 * node_cnt + 1) return flow;
        for (int i = ptr[u]; i < adj[u].size(); i++) {
            ptr[u] = i;
            Edge e = adj[u].get(i);
            if (e.cap > 0 && lvl[e.to] == lvl[u] + 1) {
                int pushed = dfs_flow(e.to, Math.min(flow, e.cap));
                if (pushed > 0) {
                    e.cap -= pushed;
                    adj[e.to].get(e.rev).cap += pushed;
                    return pushed;
                }
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    static int dinic_max_flow() {
        int total = 0;
        while (bfs_level()) {
            Arrays.fill(ptr, 0);
            int pushed;
            while ((pushed = dfs_flow(0, Integer.MAX_VALUE)) > 0) {
                total += pushed;
            }
        }
        return total;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        T = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            board1[i] = br.readLine().toCharArray();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            board2[i] = br.readLine().toCharArray();
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < 15; ++i) {
            Arrays.fill(node_id[i], -1);
        }
        node_cnt = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                if (board1[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    zero_r = i; 
                    zero_c = j;
                } else if (valid(i, j)) {
                    node_id[i][j] = ++node_cnt;
                }
            }
        }

        adj = new List[2 * node_cnt + 2];
        for (int i = 0; i < 2 * node_cnt + 2; ++i) {
            adj[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
        lvl = new int[2 * node_cnt + 2];
        ptr = new int[2 * node_cnt + 2];

        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                if (valid(i, j)) {
                    expand(i, j);
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(dinic_max_flow());
    }
}
